sources.note: Stripe API changelog in Markdown, grouped by API version (e.g. 2026-09-30.endive). Each row says Breaking or Non-breaking and links to a detail page with the affected params and migration steps. The HTML page at /changelog drops the breaking flag and the links.
API upgrade guide: pinning Stripe-Version, SDK pinning, webhook endpoint and event destination api_version.
Release model (monthly additive versions, two breaking majors a year) and the current version.
SDK semver and support policy, language runtime deprecation schedule, preview API versions.

stripe-node CHANGELOG. Each release names its pinned API version and marks breaking changes with a warning sign. The GitHub releases API for stripe-node only links to this file, so the raw file is read instead.
